tools.name: exec
tools.description: Run inline code in an interpreter (python, node, bash, ...). Use it to compute, filter or combine data in one call. Write a short answer to the file named by $EXEC_RESULT to see it ahead of the raw output. It waits up to block_ms; if the program is still running you get an id and it keeps going: use the async tool to wait for, list, inspect or stop it.

lang.description: Interpreter name, e.g. python, node, bash. Defaults to bash.

args.description: Arguments passed to the program as argv, with no shell quoting.

cwd.description: Directory to run in, relative to the workspace root or absolute. Defaults to the workspace root.

timeout_ms.description: Wall-clock budget for this call in milliseconds; clamped to the configured range.

block_ms.description: Most time to block for the result. If the program is still running an id is returned; collect it with the async tool.
